description: This PHP source file defines the FieldsMetaData class, which models metadata for fields in the DynamicFields module of SuiteCRM. It includes properties for database columns, methods for deleting records, and methods for retrieving view data and summaries.

classes.name: FieldsMetaData
classes.description: A class representing metadata for dynamic fields in SuiteCRM, extending the SugarBean class to interact with the database and provide metadata management functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the FieldsMetaData class and disables row-level security.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes a metadata record from the database by ID and marks related relationships as deleted.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for rendering list views, including translation and HTML links.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name property as a summary text for this metadata record.
